proof:
have hz : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
    norm_num at hr
  have hi : i = (1 + Complex.I) / (2 - Complex.I) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
    rw [← h₂, ← h₀, h₁]
  rw [hi]
  apply (div_eq_iff hz).2
  linear_combination -(3 / 5 : ℂ) * Complex.I_sq
